name: Sphinx Stretch
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended straight behind you and the tops of your feet resting gently on the ground.
Slide your elbows directly underneath your shoulders with your forearms parallel and palms flat on the floor.
Press lightly through your forearms to lift your chest upward while keeping your hips and pelvis relaxed against the floor.
Hold the gentle arch steadily while breathing slowly, then lower your chest smoothly back down to finish.
tips: Draw your shoulders down away from your ears and lengthen forward through your chest rather than crunching your lower back.
Walk your elbows slightly farther forward if your lower back feels tight or compressed.
